blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as effective alternatives to autoregressive models for latency-critical tasks, enabling faster token generation. Recent advances employ block diffusion with self-editing capabilities, where each block refines tokens iteratively before advancing to the next one. Yet each block is only as fast as its slowest token, and the next block cannot start before it. We suggest Blurring the Block Boundaries (B3), a novel method with which two blocks are refined in parallel within a shared forward pass. B3 calibrates itself on the fly, opening the next block only once the model is ready to start generating it. It is a training-free and hyperparameter-free acceleration method which seamlessly integrates within any self-editing block diffusion model. Evaluated on state-of-the-art DLMs across 10 diverse datasets spanning varied tasks and difficulty levels, B3 results in on par generation quality and 11.5-14.5% speedup compared to the base model, pushing the Pareto frontier for latency-quality trade-offs in DLM inference.

blocks.en: Early DLMs denoised the whole output within a single canvas with bidirectional attention Austin et al. (2021) ; Lou et al. (2024) . Since the canvas length is fixed, every forward pass contains all positions regardless of how many tokens need updating, and generation cannot extend beyond the canvas boundary. Block diffusion Arriola et al. (2025) addresses this by splitting the canvas into blocks decoded sequentially: each forward pass refines only the current block, new blocks can be appended as needed, and each block attends causally to the previous blocks via a KV cache. This approach is widely used in recent large-scale DLMs Bie et al. (2025) ; Wu et al. (2026a) ; Cheng et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026c) . State-of-the-art block DLMs DiffusionGemma Team (2026) ; Bie et al. (2026) learn to self-edit from uniform-state corruption Austin et al. (2021) , and may spend further forward passes refining a block before moving on to the next.

blocks.en:
A key observation of ours is that this artificial split into blocks carries an inherent inefficiency at block boundaries. Tokens are not equally easy to predict: some settle in a step or two, others need many more, and a block is not finalized until its slowest token is accepted.
A forward pass over a block has the same computational cost regardless of how many tokens are accepted.
At the end of a block’s denoising process, the model accepts its last few tokens or self-edits earlier ones, while the next block’s easy to predict tokens wait behind them, untouched. We show empirically that the number of tokens accepted per forward pass drops sharply near the block boundaries ( Figure 1 (a)), consistently across models and datasets ( Appendix C ).

blocks.en: In this work we present Blurring the Block Boundaries ( B3 ) , a novel approach that reduces this loss in token throughput by blurring the artificial block boundaries. Once the current block is settled enough, the next block is drafted in a shared forward pass, conditioned on the current block’s evolving state, parallelizing the end of the current block generation and the beginning of the next one ( Figure 1 (b)). Attention stays block-causal, so the current block’s predictions are left unchanged. Once the draft becomes the current block, self-editing corrects any errors it carries from being initialised before the previous block had fully converged. The spawning time of the next block is dynamically determined from statistics of the predicted tokens in previous blocks, making B3 training-free and hyperparameter-free, thus requiring no adaptation to integrate into existing models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion language models denoise either continuous token embeddings Li et al. (2022) ; Gulrajani and Hashimoto (2023) ; Chen et al. (2026) or discrete tokens. Discrete diffusion models are characterised by their corruption process, which determines whether generation can revise its own tokens. Masked diffusion replaces tokens with an absorbing [MASK] state Sahoo et al. (2024) ; Ou et al. (2025) ; Nie et al. (2025) ; Ye et al. (2025) , so generation progressively unmasks positions while revealed tokens are not revisited. Uniform-state diffusion replaces them with random vocabulary tokens Austin et al. (2021) ; Sahoo et al. (2025) ; Ye et al. (2026) ; DiffusionGemma Team (2026) , so every position is re-predicted at every step. Hybrid models mix both von Rütte et al. (2025) ; Bie et al. (2026) . Masked models can be extended with self-editing through remasking Wang et al. (2025) or self-correction objectives Schiff et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026b) . Block DLMs Arriola et al. (2025) , adapted from pretrained AR models Wu et al. (2026a) ; Fu et al. (2026) or scaled to 100B parameters Bie et al. (2025) , now underlie most recent large-scale DLMs.

For DLMs trained without blocks, sliding and adaptive schemes reshape the block imposed by the sampler at inference Luo et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2026) ; Lu et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. blocks.en:
During training, different blocks are denoised disjointly.
On the one hand, waiting for the current block to fully converge at inference time spawns the next block too late and prevents the desired overlap. On the other hand, spawning the future block too early conditions it on a still evolving current block, which may cause inference to deviate too far from training. Hence, the future block should be spawned once the tokens of the current block are settled enough.

一方面,等待目前的区块在推断时间完全会合,产生出下一个区块为时已晚并会防止所期望的重叠. 另一方面,过早地将未来区块置于一个仍在演变中的现有区块上,这可能导致推断偏离训练太远。 因此,一旦现有区块的标志物足够安放,未来区块就应该产出.

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates the slow finish of a block under vanilla decoding: acceptance falls as the block nears completion. For DiffusionGemma on HumanEval+, the last 20% of a block takes 22% of the steps but yields only 10% of the tokens (first and last block excluded). blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced B3 , a training-free and without hyperparameters acceleration method for self-editing block diffusion language models. B3 exploits a structural property of these models: late denoising steps of a block accept few tokens, so the next block can start early on the same forward passes. An entropy-based gate calibrates the spawning point from the model’s own acceptance behaviour.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了B3,一种无训练且没有超参数的加速方法,用于自编辑块传播语言模型. B3利用了这些模型的结构属性:一个块的后期去名步骤接受很少的符号,因此下个块可以在相同的前行通行证上提前开始. 基于 en的门从模型自身的接受行为来校正产卵点.

blocks.en: Experiments on three models spanning two diffusion families, hybrid (LLaDA 2.1 mini 16B and flash 100B) and USDM (DiffusionGemma 26B), and 10 diverse benchmarks show that B3 consistently improves TPS by 11.5–14.5% and TPF by 15.9–19.4%, with an average accuracy change of +0.03 pp over the three models, without any per-model or per-task tuning. On LLaDA 2.1 mini, B3 , as a plug-and-play addition, also achieves a better latency–quality trade-off than concurrent multi-block methods with tuned thresholds.
blocks.zh: 三个模型的实验涉及两个扩散家庭,即混合体(LLaDA 2.1 minial 16B和闪存100B)和USDM(DifmusionGemma 26B),以及10个不同的基准,这些实验表明,B3持续地将TPS改进了11.5-14.5%,TPF改进了15.9-19.4%,三个模型的平均精度变化为+0.03pp,没有每个模型或每个任务调试. 在LLaDA 2.1 迷你上,B3作为插座和游戏的附加,也比起同时采用多块并有调制阈值的方法,实现了更好的耐久性质量取舍。

blocks.en:
Spawning the next block too late forfeits the speedup, while spawning it too early conditions it on a still evolving prefix that can mislead its predictions.
The TPS gains suggest that the gate opens early enough to exploit the low-acceptance tail of each block.
The preserved accuracy suggests that it also opens late enough for the settled tokens of the current block to provide reliable context for the next one.
If any errors do slip past the gate, self-editing appears to correct them.
blocks.zh:
如果下一个区块出现得太晚,就会失去速度,同时使它产生太早的条件是在一个仍在演变的前缀上,这可能会误导其预测.
TPS的收益表明,该门开得足够早,可以利用每个街区的低能被接受的尾巴.
保存的准确性表明,它也为当前区块的已结算地标打开了足够晚,为下一个区块提供了可靠的上下文.
如果有错误从门上滑过,自我编辑似乎可以纠正。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: B3 relies on self-editing for having low-acceptance forwards to exploit, as well as to correct future block tokens drafted on an unfinished prefix, so masked DLMs without an editing mechanism fall outside its scope. The state-of-the-art models we evaluate, in both diffusion families, self-edit by design. The spawning gate also assumes semi left-to-right generation at parts of the generation, which both evaluated models exhibit ( Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: B3依靠自编自导,因为其接受率低而向前去开发,以及纠正在未完成前缀上所起草的未来块符号,因此没有编辑机制的蒙面DLM不属于其范围. 在两个传播家庭里,我们评价的最先进的模型都是通过设计进行自我编辑的。 产卵口还假定部分产卵口为半左到右代,这两个产卵口都评价了模型展出(附录E)。

blocks.en: Unlike verification-based speculative decoding, B3 does not guarantee outputs identical to vanilla decoding, although average accuracy changes by only − 0.40 -0.40 to + 0.76 +0.76 pp. Its speedup is bounded by the low-acceptance tail of each block. The resulting 11.5 11.5 – 14.5 % 14.5\% TPS gain is moderate.
blocks.zh: 与基于核查的投机解码不同,B3并不保证输出与香草解码完全相同,虽然平均精度变化只有−0.40-0.40到+0.76+0.76pp. 它的加速被每个区块的低能接受尾. 由此产生的11.5 11.5 — 14.5%的TPS增益是中度的.

blocks.en: Wall-clock speedups are measured on one inference stack per model and may differ in other serving regimes, such as large-batch inference. Due to compute constraints, ablations and comparisons with concurrent methods use LLaDA 2.1 mini and a subset of benchmarks. The evaluation focuses on English only text only tasks.
blocks.zh: 长城时速由每个模型的一个推想堆栈来测量,在其他服务体系中可能有所不同,如大批推论. 由于计算方面的限制,采用LLaDA2.1小型和一组基准,与同时采用的方法进行比对。 评价的重点是只有英文文本的任务。

blocks.en:
We fix two inefficiencies in LLaDA 2.1’s shipped Hugging Face inference code. First, we replace the MoE forward pass with the fused MoE kernel of vLLM Kwon et al. (2023) , as the public implementation uses a plain for loop to iterate experts, reducing GPU utilization to near 0 in our setup.
We also implement KV caching of finalized blocks. This does not affect the mini model generation speed but without it runtimes for the flash checkpoint are quadratic in length.
Both these changes were unrelated to our method, and we report all results (ours and baselines) over these changes.
blocks.zh:
我们用LLaDA 2.1 运来的 Hugging Face 推论代码来解决两个效率低下的问题。 首先,我们用VLLM Kwon等人(2023年)的已熔化的MOE内核取代了MOE前行通道,因为公共执行使用平地来环绕到地铁专家,将GPU的利用率降低到我们设置中接近0.
我们还执行KV 缓冲 最终街区。 这不影响微型模型生成速度,但没有它,闪存检查站的运行时间长度为四相.
这两个变化都与我们的方法无关,我们报告了这些变化的所有结果(我们的和基线)。

blocks.en: Confidence- and entropy-based samplers accept the most certain tokens first, inducing a task-dependent, easy-first order Kim et al. (2025) . On text, this order is commonly found to correlate with position. Sumi Ye et al. (2026) , a uniform-state DLM trained from scratch without blocks, shows a left-to-right commitment gradient on three of four tasks under confidence sampling, but not under ancestral sampling, so the gradient emerges at inference rather than being imposed by training. For DiffusionGemma, Asaria et al. (2026) report a partial left-to-right bias in commitment order on prose, code and math. Hou and Kwok (2026) find unmasking concentrated near the diagonal both for the block model SDAR and for the full-canvas LLaDA.

blocks.en: The future block is drafted while the current block is still being denoised, so it is conditioned on a prefix that may still hold noise ( Section 3 ). Self-editing is what lets the sampler revise those early guesses once the prefix settles. Table 8 measures how often this happens. For every token of a block that is finalised, it compares the token accepted first with the token the block finalises with, on all 164 HumanEval+ problems. The vanilla rows count tokens accepted in the current block, the only kind vanilla decoding has; the B3 rows count tokens accepted while their block was still the future block.
blocks.zh: 未来区块是在目前区块仍在被去诺化时被起草的,因此它以一个仍然可能保持噪音的前缀为条件(第3节. 自我编辑是让采样者在前缀解决后修改这些早期猜测的. 表8衡量了这种情况的发生频率。 对于一个最终完成的区块的每个标志,它将首先接受的标志和最终完成的标志与所有164个HumanEval+问题的标志进行比较. 香草行会算出被当前块接受的活符,唯一一种花香草解码有; B3行会算出被接受的活符,而他们的活符仍然是未来块.

blocks.en: DiffusionGemma encodes its history with fully causal attention, which does not change the forward pass of B3 . Our method operates on DiffusionGemma’s token-level causal KV cache, and only the current and future blocks attend block-causally ( Figure 3 ). Once the current block is finalized ( committed , in DiffusionGemma’s terminology), it is re-encoded with token-level causal attention and pushed to the history, exactly as in the regular DiffusionGemma inference stack.
blocks.zh: 分解Gemma用完全因果的注意力来编码其历史,这不会改变B3的前传. 我们的方法在 DifmusionGemma 的符号级因子 KV 缓存上运行, 只有当前和未来的区块会因地制取(图3) 。 一旦当前块被最终确定(承诺,在DifmusionGemma的名词中),它就被重新编码,以象征性的因果关注,并被推向历史,与常规的DifmusionGemma推论堆一样.
